name: dom-inspector
description: Pick DOM elements in your running app and send them, with their component, selectors, styles and HTML, to any AI assistant (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Kiro, Cline, Roo Code, Continue, MCP clients…)

commands.title: DOM Inspector: Inspect Cursor Browser Tab
DOM Inspector: Detach from Current Page
DOM Inspector: Set Up MCP for AI Tools…

enumDescriptions: The editor’s own browser when it has one (VS Code integrated browser, Cursor browser tab), otherwise the DOM Inspector panel.
VS Code’s integrated browser (a full Chromium view with its own DevTools).
DOM Inspector’s own panel, with a reload and inspect toolbar.
Your system browser (Chrome, Firefox…). The inspector still talks to the editor.
domInspector.browser.markdownDescription: Where **Open URL** shows the page. Every option loads the page through DOM Inspector’s local proxy, so inspection and Send to AI work the same everywhere.

enumDescriptions: Use the assistant you last chose with "Send to…", otherwise the first one installed (custom command, Claude Code, Cline, Roo Code, Continue, Kiro, Cursor, Copilot), otherwise the clipboard.
Claude Code extension: @-mentions the element snapshot in the chat input.
Cursor built-in chat: adds the snapshot file to the current chat.
Kiro agent: adds the snapshot file as #[[file:…]] context.
VS Code chat (GitHub Copilot): opens chat with the snapshot attached.
Cline: adds the snapshot to the chat input.
Roo Code: adds the snapshot to the chat context.
Continue: adds the snapshot file as context.
Copies the element context as Markdown.
domInspector.ai.target.markdownDescription: Where **Send to AI** delivers picked elements. Everything else can use `custom`, the clipboard, the snapshot files in `.dom-inspector/`, or the MCP server.

domInspector.ai.customCommand.markdownDescription: Command ID to run for the `custom` target, e.g. another AI extension’s “add file to chat” command.

domInspector.ai.customArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments for `customCommand`. Placeholders: `${file}` (the snapshot as a Uri), `${path}`, `${relativePath}`, `${markdown}`, `${prompt}`.

domInspector.ai.customSelectSnapshot.markdownDescription: Open the snapshot and select all of it before running `customCommand`, for commands that read the active editor selection.

domInspector.mcp.autoConfigure.markdownDescription: Register the bundled MCP server with this editor’s own AI on startup: Kiro (`.kiro/settings/mcp.json`), Cursor (`.cursor/mcp.json`) or VS Code (`.vscode/mcp.json`). Use **DOM Inspector: Set Up MCP for AI Tools…** for other clients.

domInspector.mcp.port.markdownDescription: Port of the MCP server’s local HTTP bridge (written into MCP configs as `DOM_INSPECTOR_PORT`).

scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm compile && pnpm bundle-mcp
scripts.package: pnpm bump && pnpm build && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --no-dependencies --baseContentUrl .
